# memflex — llms.txt (AI-search friendly summary)

> Memflex gives AI agents reflexes + verified memory. Repeated requests are
> answered from memory in ~50ms at ₹0, in any language. The LLM runs only for
> what the agent has never seen.

## Integrate (any framework)
- OpenAI protocol: POST https://YOUR-SERVER/v1/chat/completions
- Claude protocol: POST https://YOUR-SERVER/v1/messages
- Python: from reflex.plug import openai_client / anthropic_client
- LangGraph: ReflexNode / MemflexNode; Mem0 shim: from reflex.compat import mem0

## Key endpoints
- POST /ask (hit: instant answer; miss: LLM then auto-distilled to reflex)
- POST /remember, POST /reflexes (explicit memorize, upsert)
- GET /reflexes, GET /activity (every LLM call vs every reflex answer)
- GET /metrics (hit_rate, ₹ saved, latency, calibration)
- POST /reflexes/{id}/feedback (thumbs up/down tunes confidence)
- POST /verify/run (re-check stale memories), DELETE /reflexes/{id}

## Docs
- Full guide: https://memflex.dev/docs
- Compare (Jev, Mem0, Portkey, GPTCache): https://memflex.dev/compare
- Benchmarks: https://memflex.dev/benchmarks
